title: SIMAI Document Port 1.0.0 (draft 2): the stored element, its levels and its answers
description: The data a host of simai.document-port answers with. One storage element holds one page, section or site level: a value per language, every value a simai.composition.document, and one revision for all of them. A level's value is written the way a Recipe fills regions: an area the value leaves out inherits, an area it carries replaces, an area it carries empty ([]) clears. The resolved document is what the editor shows: the level's value over its parents, every layout.region marked with where it came from. A host answers every stored value back as it was sent, unknown content included, or refuses the write would-lose; nothing is stored with less.

key.description: An opaque token: a revision, a client key, a host reference. Compared exactly; a host that counts revisions sends the number as a decimal string.

ref.description: A host reference to a storage element or a level: a host id (site:s1, page:4217) or a path, percent-encoded as in a URL (section:/catalog/, section:/%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3/, upper-case hex). Opaque to the editor: it never builds or splits one.

revision.description: The revision of the whole storage element: every language under one revision. It changes with every applied write and is never reused.

client_key.description: A stable key per write the editor makes once and keeps until the write is answered. A repeat with the same key and the same parameters is the same write and is answered with the stored result; the same key with other parameters is an idempotency-conflict.

language.description: A language tag. As a key of values, resolved or a write it is one of the element's languages exactly as listed: tags are not folded by case, so RU beside ru is unknown-language.

target.description: The storage element the editor works on. The host binds it (a signed context, a route); the editor never names a target in a write.

parents.description: The levels this one inherits from, nearest first; the site last.

document.description: One language's value. Its locale, when present, is the language it stands under.

values.description: The value per language. A language without a value is absent: a missing translation is never answered with another language's value. Each value is answered back as it was stored, equal to what was sent (key order aside, the simai:area key removed), whatever node types, data, props, extensions and bindings it holds. A value's locale, when present, is its key; one that differs is refused structure-mismatch. Until the media edition a media file is referred to by an opaque media:<id> string in props or data, kept like any other value.

values_write.description: The languages a save writes. A language left out keeps its stored value; null removes that language's value (not the main language's, the first of languages: that is refused invalid; a removal is kept in history, and rights.languages applies to it as to a write). The write is one revision for the whole element. A value may be the resolved document as shown: its simai:area marks are read and removed, never stored.

area_state.description: Recipe's three outcomes for a slot: missing inherits, passed replaces, [] clears.

area_mark.description: The mark on a layout.region of the resolved document, under extensions["simai:area"]. A stored value never carries it. On a save the host removes the simai:area key and keeps every other key of the region's extensions; a region marked state inherited is not stored (the area goes on inheriting), unless its content differs from the parent's area, which is refused would-lose.

locked.description: A level above holds the area: this level may not replace or clear it.

additionalProperties.description: The same mark, keyed by the region's name, for an editor that shows the areas apart from the canvas.

areas.description: Every area of the resolved document by its name. An area's state is the same in every language; its content is each language's.

resolved.description: Per language, the level's value over its parents with the area marks. Only for the languages the element has a value in.

languages.description: The languages the reader may write; absent: every language of the element.

limits.description: Per stored language value. 1.0.0 holds a host to at most 200 nodes and 262144 bytes; a host may announce less, never more. Nodes are every node of the document (root, layout shells, regions and content). Bytes are the UTF-8 bytes of the compact serialization of the value as sent, simai:area keys removed: JSON with no spacing and non-ASCII written as itself (JSON.stringify), not escaped. resolved is not limited.

id.description: The publication itself; a rollback makes a new one.

languages.description: The languages it published: those with a value at that revision, or the ones asked.

from.description: A rollback: the publication it repeats.

author.description: Who published or rolled back, as the host names people; null when it does not say.

current.description: What a conflict carries beside current_revision: the stored element as it is now, so the editor shows it next to the unsaved input and loses neither. A stale-revision conflict carries values, and with levels resolved and areas; an environment-changed one carries published.

more.description: Whether each list of history.list goes on past the page answered.
